aarti.tek: Om, victory to Mother Yamunā; Hari Om, victory to Mother Yamunā. Whoever bathes in her gains the fruit; she is the giver of joy and sorrow.
aarti.pad1: The water of Śrī Yamunā is holy; her cool, deep stream flows on. Whoever came to her refuge, she set free. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Whoever rises at dawn, bathes every day and meditates every day, does not suffer the terror of Yama. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: In the Kali age your glory has remained unshaken; the four Vedas have told of your great holiness. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Mother, the Lord came to your banks and took his avatāra there; drinking your ever-pure water, he killed Kaṁsa. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Salutations, Mother, remover of fear, bringer of all that is good and auspicious. My mind has grown restless; without you, the Vaitaraṇī lies before me. ॥5॥
